population.kidComparison: About 47.4 million people live in Algeria—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Algeria
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Algeria.

exploration.didYouKnow: Algeria is located in Northern Africa and its capital city is Algiers.
